# Wacom

> Wacom is a leading provider of pen tablets, interactive pen displays, and digital creativity tools for professionals, artists, and educators.

Wacom offers a comprehensive range of pen-based input devices including the Cintiq interactive displays, MovinkPad portable tablets, and Wacom One entry-level products. The company serves creative professionals, students, and educators with innovative pen technology and digital art solutions.

## Products & Solutions

- [Wacom Pen Tablets & Interactive Pen Displays](https://www.wacom.com/en-us/products): Main product catalog featuring Wacom pen tablets and interactive displays
- [Interactive Pen Displays & Touch Screen Tablets](https://www.wacom.com/en-us/products/pen-displays): Interactive pen display product line including Cintiq and Movink series
- [Portable pads](https://www.wacom.com/en-us/products/portable-pads): Portable pen tablet lineup including MovinkPad Pro and MovinkPad 11
